item.title: Everything We Know About GTA 7
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has only just been released, so it might seem a bit early to start thinking about Grand Theft Auto 7 . I swear I’m not just writing an “Everything we know about GTA 7” article just so I can stuff a post with the “Everything we know about GTA 7” keyword and have Polygon own “Everything we know about GTA 7” search queries. That would be quite a gambit.

item.title: 8 Near-Perfect Fantasy Miniseries That Hook You in the First Episode
item.description: Fantasy television has given us some of the most imaginative stories ever told, transporting viewers to magical kingdoms, mysterious alternate realities, and worlds filled with creatures that shouldn't exist. Shows like Game of Thrones and Rings of Power dominate the conversation, pushing some of the genre's best storytelling to the forefront, but there’s something to be said of the smaller productions and shorter stories.

item.title: 'Steps' Ending Explained: Director Reveals the True Meaning Behind Cinderella Adaptation
item.description: Netflix’s newest animated sensation, directed by Alyce Tzue ( Soar ) and John Ripa ( Raya and the Last Dragon ), dares to ask: what if Cinderella’s ugly stepsisters weren’t so ugly and bad after all, but were instead besieged by a Western world that reacted to their East Asian heritage with distrust and unease?

item.title: Who is Johannes Zuch supposed to be in GTA 6?
item.description: Everyone is a target in Grand Theft Auto 6 . Even Jonathan Blow, the puzzle game designer known for The Witness and Order of the Sinking Star , isn’t safe.

item.title: 10 New Movies to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, Prime Video, and HBO Max (November 20 - 22)
item.description: Happy weekend! The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is out in theaters, seemingly putting an end to one of the biggest franchises in recent years. It’s pretty good.

item.title: GTA 6 Players Are Officially Spending an ‘Absolutely Bonkers’ Amount of Time with the Game
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 players weren't kidding about wanting to spend the game's entire launch day in Leonida. Much hullabaloo was made about people requesting time off from work or faking sick to spend the entire day playing GTA 6 , and plenty of companies tried to capitalize on that conversation with marketing stunts .

item.title: Every Free Game This Week on Steam, Epic, and Xbox (Nov. 20-26)
item.description: Every week, there are limited-time offers that allow players to enjoy games for free, whether as temporary or permanent additions to their digital libraries. Here's everything that frugal and curious gaming fans can enjoy between Nov. 20 and Nov. 26, so they can make the most of their week without spending a dime.

item.title: 'Baldur’s Gate 3' Official Prequel Announced for 2027
item.description: The world of Baldur’s Gate 3 is expanding beyond video games once again, with a new official prequel novel set to explore the darker corners of the Forgotten Realms. The upcoming book will take readers beneath the streets of Baldur’s Gate, where a murder threatens to expose the secrets of a secretive religious order.

item.title: 44 Years Later, Steven Spielberg's Scariest Movie of All Time Is Officially Free on Streaming
item.description: Poltergeist , which became available to stream for free on Pluto TV on Nov. 1 , follows an ordinary suburban family that begins to experience strange things in their home. Furniture and toys move on their own, a glass of milk shatters out of nowhere, and the youngest child in the family, 5-year-old Carol Anne (Heather O'Rourke), begins to communicate with beings through the television. At first, these events are dismissed, but during a thunderstorm one night, a tree outside the windows of the kids’ room crashes in and snatches the boy. Then, a portal opens in their closet, sucking Carol Anne into another dimension. With help from some paranormal investigators, the family tries everything to bring her back.

item.title: 8 New TV Shows to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, Disney, and Paramount (November 20-22)
item.description: Happy weekend! Genre fans have plenty to look forward to when it comes to TV . Earlier this week, Netflix announced the return of 3 Body Project , the heady sci-fi series based on the Liu Cixin novels and adapted by the Game of Thrones showrunners. No big deal. Other series you can look forward to soon include Alien: Earth season 2 and Neuromancer . This month, Blade Runner 2099 is premiering on Prime Video.
